record.paper_title: Open problems on graphs arising from geometric topology
record.original_question: Let M and M' be closed orientable PL 4-manifolds. For a closed PL n-manifold, define its k-complexity c_k(M) by minimizing, over all colored graphs representing M, the rank of the chain module C_{n-k}(G), and define the reduced complexity by subtracting the corresponding baseline complexity of the n-sphere. Is the reduced 4-complexity additive under connected sum, namely does c_tilde_4(M # M') = c_tilde_4(M) + c_tilde_4(M') hold?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and definitions. A colored graph of dimension n+1 is a pair (G, γ) where G = (V(G), E(G)) is a finite multigraph (loops forbidden) which is regular of degree n+1, and γ : E(G) → {0,1,…,n} is an edge-coloring such that distinct edges sharing a vertex have distinct colors. Such a graph has an associated n-dimensional pseudocomplex K(G): take an n-simplex σ_v for each vertex v ∈ V(G), labeled at its vertices by {0,1,…,n}, and glue σ_v to σ_w along the (n−1)-face opposite to the vertex labeled c whenever v and w are joined by an edge colored c. The colored graph (G, γ) is said to represent the closed PL n-manifold M if |K(G)| is PL-homeomorphic to M; every closed PL n-manifold admits such a representing colored graph.

For each integer k with 0 ≤ k ≤ n, let C_{n−k}(G) be the free abelian group generated by the (n−k)-dimensional simplices of K(G) (equivalently, the (k+1)-residues of (G, γ) of an appropriate type), and let rk C_{n−k}(G) denote its rank. Define the k-complexity of a closed PL n-manifold M by
    c_k(M) = min { rk C_{n−k}(G) : (G, γ) is a colored graph representing M }.
Let S^n denote the n-sphere, and define the reduced k-complexity by
    c̃_k(M) = c_k(M) − c_k(S^n).

Connected sum of two closed orientable PL n-manifolds M and M' is denoted M # M'.

Problem. Let M and M' be closed orientable PL 4-manifolds. Determine whether the reduced 4-complexity is additive under connected sum, that is, whether
    c̃_4(M # M') = c̃_4(M) + c̃_4(M')
holds for every such pair (M, M').
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches surface related results on additivity of regular genus and on gem-complexity / k-complexity invariants of 4-manifolds via crystallizations (notably work of Casali–Cristofori), where additivity is established only under restrictive hypotheses such as the existence of (weak) semi-simple crystallizations. No source verifies the conjectured additivity of the reduced 4-complexity under connected sum in full generality, and it continues to be stated as a conjecture; we therefore record it as open.

status_evidence.title: Crystallizations of compact 4-manifolds minimizing combinatorially defined PL-invariants
status_evidence.snippet: proves the additivity of regular genus with respect to connected sum for all compact 4-manifolds with empty or connected boundary which admit weak semi-simple crystallizations
status_evidence.claim: Additivity-type results for PL-invariants of 4-manifolds via colored graphs are known only under restrictive hypotheses, not in general.

status_evidence.title: Crystallizations of compact 4-manifolds minimizing combinatorially defined PL-invariants (Semantic Scholar)
status_evidence.snippet: special classes of crystallizations of compact PL 4-manifolds ... minimizing combinatorially defined PL-invariants such as regular genus, Gurau degree, gem-complexity and trisection genus
status_evidence.claim: The complexity invariants in question are an active topic; general additivity under connected sum is not asserted.
